tagline: Space and page lookups for remote teammates — page edits need your approval.
requirements: Set ATLASSIAN_SITE_NAME (for your-company.atlassian.net use your-company), ATLASSIAN_USER_EMAIL, and ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN in the host environment. Confluence Cloud only. Atlassian's own MCP server is remote-only, so this entry uses a well-maintained community stdio server.

tools.name: conf_get
tools.note: Reads any Confluence REST endpoint the token can access, including page content and attachments. Scope the API token to the spaces you intend to share.

tools.name: conf_post
tools.note: Creates pages, comments, and other resources.

seo.description: Share Confluence MCP tools with MCPWire. Configure an Atlassian API token on the host, read spaces and pages over P2P, and keep page writes out of the allowlist.
